---
title: "Testing"
description: "Scan a synthetic document with a test credential to get a known outcome."
---

<Steps>
  <Step title="Get a test credential">
    Ask us for an application in test mode.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Scan a document below">
    Each one returns the outcome shown when you open it.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Check the result">
    `onComplete` fires and [Retrieve a scan](/external/api/get-scan) returns that outcome.
  </Step>
</Steps>

<Tabs>

        </Frame>
